title: IFCB Daily Taxonomic Abundance (objects per mL)
description: Daily taxon-specific abundance estimates derived from Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) instruments across the global IFCB network, processed from the WHOI IFCB Data Archive (https://ifcb-data.whoi.edu). Each item in this collection represents a site-specific IFCB deployment and contains daily summaries generated by aggregating per-bin classification outputs over a calendar day and converting them to taxon-specific object concentrations (objects/mL) using a winner-takes-all classification approach. Metadata typically include sampling location (latitude/longitude), instrument identifier, analyzed volume, classification threshold, and per-taxon abundance. At present, this collection includes a single item for the Martha’s Vineyard Coastal Observatory (MVCO), with additional IFCB sites intended to be added as they are processed.
license: Open access; see WHOI IFCB Data Archive for source terms.
